findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are stored in plaintext in the Lambda function's environment variables. Anyone with describe permissions on the Lambda function can read these credentials, and the secrets are committed in the Terraform source file.
The Lambda function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which has reached end-of-life and no longer receives security patches while continuing to execute.
